We propose a study that uses asymptotic formula as a bridge: first, review how illiquidity and stochastic volatility are each currently treated through asymptotic formula; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
